annotations.text: Main: the live SfN 2026 page. Frosted glass buttons, glass icon chips, card hover glow, and a Biotium Choice badge glow (blue) throughout — the committed glass direction, same as GlassVariant.
GlassVariant: kept as a reference copy alongside Main now that its glass treatment has been committed to the live page. Content and behavior are otherwise identical to Main.

QuietFieldVariant: same as Main, but the hero's static neuron photo is replaced with a live interactive canvas — a dot-and-line neuron network, off-white background, quiet/sparse on the left behind the copy and thickening into a dense synapse-like tangle on the right. Hover or click lights nodes up in biotium blue and hands a pulse along their connections to neighbors.

SynapticMeshVariant: same as Main, but the hero is a two-column layout with the copy on the left and a boxed, off-white interactive WebGL neuron mesh (three.js) occupying the right column — a branching dendrite structure that pulses biotium blue on hover/click, rather than a full-bleed background.
